name: Rapid resale or return of recently acquired asset
description: An asset is bought and quickly resold or returned for a refund in a different payment form, with no apparent reason or improvement.
fp: Genuine market changes or buyer remorse can cause quick resale.

sources.text: FATF, Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing in the Art and Antiquities Market (2023)
FATF, Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Risks and Vulnerabilities Associated with Gold (2015)
FATF, Guidance on the Risk-Based Approach for Dealers in Precious Metals and Stones (2008)
FATF, Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Through the Real Estate Sector (2007)
FATF and Egmont Group, Concealment of Beneficial Ownership (2018)
FATF, Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach: Real Estate Sector (2022)
